changelog: - **Tanks of one colour read apart in the Timeline, and Games keeps its arrow on its line.** When several Pools drawn in the Timeline share a flow colour, as the desalination example's four water tanks do, each after the first now takes a chart colour of its own, the same in the chart, its legend and the step reading; each keeps its line pattern, and the tanks keep their colour on the canvas. In File ▸ Templates, the "›" of Games and the "‹" of the row back to the Templates now stand on the same line as their names; in v0.32.0 each fell to a line of its own.
